handle.representation: a Copy struct holding a reference to a SplitMix64 state cell that lives for the program (one pointer)
handle.ownership: every copy of a handle draws from the same stream; `seeded` creates an independent stream
handle.created_by: Host.capabilities(), called once by main (11.6); every other handle of this type is derived from that one

ownership.receiver: the handle by value (a Copy handle: copied, never consumed)
ownership.bound: a value, Int<1..> (refused statically below 1; a contract_violation defect natively if reached)

below.allocation: none (rejection sampling on the stream, no modulo bias)
below.cancellation: not a cancellation point: the operation completes; a cancellation of the task is observed at its next await (12.4)

ownership.receiver: the handle by value (a Copy handle: copied, never consumed)

seeded.allocation: one 8-byte state cell per call, living for the program (shared by every copy of the new handle)
seeded.cancellation: not a cancellation point: the operation completes; a cancellation of the task is observed at its next await (12.4)
